about.title: About Xravity
about.p1: Xravity is an independent technology studio helping people stay capable, independent, and secure as AI changes the way we work.
about.p2: We share practical ideas, useful resources, and focused tools for people who want more agency over their work and future.
about.p3: The long-term goal is simple: make technology feel more understandable, more useful, and more yours.
